page.title: Koneek ko
page.intro: Kobaik advertising account ko am. Lead ko jen ad ko am rej itok ilo My Leads ilo air make, ippāñ joñan im wōnāān kajjojo lead.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form ej tellok ñan My Leads, joñan jolet im joñan wōnan kajjojo lead, im lead quality eo ej jilkinlok ñan LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: Ejjab dedelok ilo server in kiõ

banner.connected: LinkedIn connected. Lead ko rej bōktok kiō - peij in ej kōkāāl ilo jidik ien.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ejjab bed ilo server in kiõ. Juon ri tel ej aikuj in kobaik LinkedIn app eo an client ID im secret.
banner.expired: LinkedIn connection eo emoj an jemlok, innem lead ko rejjab sync. Bar kobalok ñan wōnmanlok.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn ej aikuj bwe kwon bar sign in mokta jen {{date}} . Bar kōppeļaak mokta jen ien eo ñan kōmman bwe en wōr wōt lead ko.

connect.title: Connect LinkedIn
connect.intro: Deloñ ilo LinkedIn account eo ej lale ad ko am. Leadrat ej baj riiti wōt ad account ko am, Lead Gen Form leads im ad statistics, im jilkintok conversion ko kwoj kōmmane.
connect.need1: Juon jerbal ilo LinkedIn ad account (Viewer ak elaplok).
connect.need2: Juon jerbal ilo peij in kombani eo ej link (Administrator, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator ak Analyst) - LinkedIn ej aikuji bwe en kwalok lead ko.
connect.need3: Juon kajitok kin nomba in talboon ilo Lead Gen Forms eo am - lead ko ejelok nomba in talboon rejjab maroñ in kobaiktok.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Kwalok ñan LinkedIn wōn ian ri tel ro an rar erom ri wia ro remol. Ñe juon LinkedIn lead ej tõpar juon joñan eo kwoj kãlete iumin, Leadrat ej report e ñan LinkedIn , bwe ripoot in campaign ko am ren kwalok lead quality im LinkedIn en maroñ lo elaplok armij ro rej einwõt lead ko am remõntata. LinkedIn lead ID eo wōt im juon hash in email eo rej jilkintok.
capi.noRules: Ejelok status ko kar map kaki.
capi.created: Oktak eo kar kōmmane ilo LinkedIn im kar map e.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.intro: Men otemjej ikōtaan Leadrat im LinkedIn : kōtaan ko, aolep sync, aolep lead im ta eo eaar waļo̧k n̄an e, oktak ko im bōd ko.
